content: gitui: Rust TUI git client. Features: diff view with syntax highlighting (limited), hunk+line staging, blame, commit log search, branch management, / to search files. Navigation: tab-based panels (status/log/stash/branches), arrow keys for file list, d for diff. No native side-by-side diff. No full-file mode toggle. Keybindings configurable. Available via brew/pacman/cargo. Active project on GitHub.
